findings.finding: Label length had a reject test at 65 chars but no accept test at exactly 64. The task edge-cases call out the 64-vs-65 boundary explicitly; without a 64-accept test an off-by-one regression (>= vs >) would go uncaught.

All task TDD anchors covered: broken edge (callback + next), MENU-without-callback, 3 URL-scheme negatives (javascript:/leading-whitespace/empty-host), too-many-buttons, PATCH→GET round-trip (server id + preserved client id + null End target), reorder-preserves-by-id, fan-in+loop, duplicate-id. Integration test type is correct (MockMvc + Testcontainers, no excessive mocking); assertions check real HTTP status, business $.code, and round-tripped JSON values.
